description: A comprehensive shell script designed for testing the RDK Window Manager functionalities, including display creation, client management, key intercepts, key injections, inactivity reporting, input event enabling/disabling, key repeat configurations, and related error handling. It automates a variety of test cases by invoking relevant API calls via curl and validating responses, with extensive detailed test procedures embedded as functions.

methods.name: killWesterosTestApp
methods.description: Kills the westeros_test process if running to ensure a clean state before/after tests.

methods.name: createDisplayAndLaunchGoogleBrowser
methods.description: Creates a display and launches the Google Chrome browser within a WebKitBrowser plugin for testing web input scenarios.

methods.name: deactivateWebKitBrowser
methods.description: Deactivates the WebKitBrowser, typically to reset state between tests.

methods.name: testAPI
methods.description: Executes a curl command to call a given API and validates its response against an expected result.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Processes the curl output to confirm success or failure based on result or error fields.

methods.name: invoke_function
methods.description: Maps the main argument to the corresponding test function and executes it.

methods.name: testAll
methods.description: Runs the entire suite of tests sequentially.
